thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] embeddings QPS spike detected (us-west-2). slice=embed_hot, 3x baseline, error rate +4%. Auto-escalating to oncall.

alice_oncall: I'm on it. grabbing quick dashboard -> looks like one tenant burst + several small bursts. starting live triage.

jordan_sre: pinged. can you confirm which endpoints are hot? chat vs embeddings vs rerank?

alice_oncall: embeddings=primary source. chat steady. some rerank requests spiking for a downstream customer (ShopPulse) but errors align with embed throttles.

mike_eng: if embed KV cache is getting cold that can spike backend usage. any recent deploys to embedding model or routing?

alice_oncall: no deploys in last 30m. metrics: token generation latencies OK, queue depth rising on embed workers.

ani_pm: customer-facing: ShopPulse reported 503s in support ticket #SP-620. they said search relevance dropped. keep me posted.

lucy_support: confirmed, ticket attached: https://support.redwood/SP-620 — they see intermittent timeouts for embedding requests since ~08:12.

alice_oncall: mitigation plan: 1) carve per-endpoint QPS (reduce embeddings slice for noisy tenants) 2) enable safe-mode traffic-shield (circuit-breaker for non-critical rerank routes) 3) add temporary global soft-rate limit for embeddings while we stabilize. executing now.

jordan_sre: +1. suggest targeting tenant_slice=embed_hot first so we don't affect healthy customers. I can apply carve and monitor.

alice_oncall: running command to set carve for embed_hot slice to 20qps:

```
rbctl quota patch --endpoint=embeddings --slice=embed_hot --qps=20 --reason="live-mitigation 1901234567"
```

ops-bot: Command accepted. New quota applied (embeddings, slice=embed_hot) -> 20 qps.

alice_oncall: applying safe-mode for rerank non-critical route /v1/rerank/async:

```
rbctl route toggle --route=/v1/rerank/async --mode=safe --policy=circuit-breaker --threshold=5m
```

ops-bot: Route toggled to safe-mode. Requests beyond threshold will return 429.

mike_eng: also enabling short-lived global soft-limit for embeddings to smooth bursts (backfill will queue):

```
rbctl global-rate set --service=embeddings --qps=350 --duration=10m --note="soft-limit during mitigation"
```

ops-bot: Global soft-limit set: embeddings 350 qps for 10m.

alice_oncall: monitoring panels — error rate is dropping, queue depth trending down. ShopPulse errors decreasing (support ticket updated).

lucy_support: ShopPulse confirms fewer 503s, but they report some degraded throughput. passing update to account manager.

jordan_sre: capturing actions in incident log and snapshotting routing config. next steps: 1) run heap/kv cache warmup job for embed workers 2) review tenant rate attribution to identify noisy client(s) 3) draft follow-up postmortem + runbook entry for embed hot-slice actions.

ani_pm: please call out customer impact and mitigation timeline in the incident notes. I'll coordinate comms if we need a targeted message.

alice_oncall: handing off to jordan for stabilization and follow-through. jordan -> you're owner for next 2 hours, will update the incident channel and escalate if we need capacity changes.

jordan_sre: taking over. logged owner tag. will re-evaluate after soft-limit expires. planning: if errors reappear, we'll raise embed_hot carve to 25qps and carve a dedicated capacity slice for the noisy tenant.

alice_oncall: thanks. oncall clear from my side. leaving a short checklist in the incident doc.

jordan_sre: checklist saved. created follow-up ticket: INF-8472 (investigate embed spikes, add auto-carve rule when per-tenant qps > 2x baseline for 5m).

ops-bot: Incident snapshot: 1901234567 | mitigations applied: per-endpoint carve (embed_hot=20qps), route safe-mode (/v1/rerank/async), global soft-limit embeddings 350qps. owner=jordan_sre.

alice_oncall: marking pager resolved for my shift. please ping if anything regresses. :thumbsup:

jordan_sre: will follow up with postmortem + runbook edits. assigning action items to eng and support.

lucy_support: I will update the ShopPulse ticket with mitigation summary and expected follow-up.

ani_pm: thanks team. good coordination.

incident-bot: [CLOSE] Automated check after 10m: error rate stable below threshold, no further escalations. Keep monitoring.
